Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-352.

Covers:
- `\newtheorem`-declared theorem and lemma sharing the global theorem counter.
- Optional `[Main]` annotation rendered as parenthesized title suffix.
- Plain `proof` env: unnumbered, gets ∎ appended.
- `\label` inside theorem-like envs (currently not surfaced in markdown output;
  preserved as QuoteBlock.label internally).

QuoteBlock admonitions render as `> **Title.** body` blockquotes per
src/arxiv_md/tex/rendering.py::_render_quote and the numbering rules in
src/arxiv_md/tex/transform/handlers/theorems.py.
